title: The Future of After-School Classes
synopsis: The Chinese government has been cracking down on the country’s after-school tutoring industry.

fullText.simplified:
课外班的明天在哪里？

    说起中国教育，相信不少人听说过：中国考试很难，学生很累。特别是两千年以后，从大城市开始，考试越来越难。家长们害怕孩子考不好，就会把孩子送到课外班学习。所以很多学生放学以后，除了完成学校作业，还会参加很多课外班。
    慢慢地，最开始不想去课外班的学生也只能去上课，因为每个人都在上课，不上课的人就会在考试中失败。
    就这样，课外班越来越多，不少人发现了这个机会，开起了课外班。但是没有人知道他们教得怎么样。越来越多钱进入了教育公司，事情也变得越来越奇怪：学生们越来越忙，家长的钱越花越多，但没有人真的赢了，除了教育公司。
    从2021年三月起，中国政府开始要求学校开课后班，让学生们在学校做作业，没有时间去上课外班了。
    课外班的冬天真的来了吗？没人知道，可能考试还在，就总有课外班会开下去。
fullText.traditional:
課外班的明天在哪裏？

    說起中國教育，相信不少人聽說過：中國考試很難，學生很累。特別是兩千年以後，從大城市開始，考試越來越難。家長們害怕孩子考不好，就會把孩子送到課外班學習。所以很多學生放學以後，除了完成學校作業，還會參加很多課外班。
    慢慢地，最開始不想去課外班的學生也只能去上課，因為每個人都在上課，不上課的人就會在考試中失敗。
    就這樣，課外班越來越多，不少人發現了這個機會，開起了課外班。但是沒有人知道他們教得怎麼樣。越來越多錢進入了教育公司，事情也變得越來越奇怪：學生們越來越忙，家長的錢越花越多，但沒有人真的贏了，除了教育公司。
    從2021年三月起，中國政府開始要求學校開課後班，讓學生們在學校做作業，沒有時間去上課外班了。
    課外班的冬天真的來了嗎？沒人知道，可能考試還在，就總有課外班會開下去。

raw.synopsis: The Chinese government has been cracking down on the country’s after-school tutoring industry.
sentence_translations: What is the Future of After-School Classes?
.. I’m sure many people have heard that Chinese exams are very difficult, and students are very tired.
Especially after 2000, starting from the big cities, exams have become more and more difficult.
Parents fear that their children will perform poorly in exams and send their children to after-school classes to study.
So after school, many students, as well as completing school homework, also attend many after-school classes.
Gradually, students who initially didn’t want to attend after-school classes had no choice but to attend them, ..
.. because everyone was attending these classes, and the people who didn’t attend would fail in exams.
In this way, there were more and more after-school classes.
Many people discovered this opportunity and started running after-school classes.
But nobody knows how well they teach.
More and more money went into education companies, and the situation also became more and more strange:
Students have become more and more busy, parents have spent more and more money, ..
.. but nobody has really won, other than the education companies.
From March 2021, the Chinese government has started demanding schools run their own after-school classes, ..
.. so that students do their homework at school and don’t have time to attend other after-school classes.
Has the winter of after-school classes really arrived?
Nobody knows. Maybe, as long as there are exams, there will inevitably be after-school classes.
